source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The gray divider separates the three choices from the repeated lower object.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    bottom = [(r, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    br0 = min(r for r, c in bottom)
    bc0 = min(c for r, c in bottom)

    # Select the rightmost of the three upper shapes.
    unseen = {(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)}
    components = []
    while unseen:
        seed = unseen.pop()
        comp = {seed}
        q = [seed]
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for p in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)

    sr0 = min(r for r, c in chosen)

    return out
